verdict.rationale: The docs describe Open WebUI as a self-hosted platform "built to run entirely offline" with native Ollama support and any OpenAI-compatible API, and list vLLM and LM Studio as OpenAI-compatible backends added via a custom Base URL. An air-gapped deployment mode is also documented, so a fully local, no-cloud-model setup is clearly supported. Missing for 10: llama.cpp is never named explicitly (only implied through OpenAI-compatible support); the vLLM/LM Studio listing comes from the Computer ecosystem docs rather than the core WebUI connection docs; no independent hands-on corroboration of fully offline local-model operation.
